message:
I couldn't fix it, because the cause is in a file I'm not allowed to edit.

The upload limit is set in `config/default.json`, where `uploads.maxMb` is `5`. `docs/product.md` says 10 MB. That's why an 8 MB file is rejected, and why the 12 MB rejection test fails: its message expects "max 10 MB" but gets "max 5 MB". The validator in `src/uploads/validate.js` just reads this value, so its code is fine.

A Fenceline rule on this project ("config/: shared with ops, off-limits") blocked my edit to that file. I haven't tried to get around it. `npm test` still shows 2 of the 4 tests failing, the two tests on the size limit.

The fix is one line in `config/default.json`:

```json
"maxMb": 10
```

`src/api/body-limit.js` computes the request body cap from the same value, so it will rise to 11 MB along with it.

Do you want to lift the fence on `config/` so I can make the change? Or, since ops shares that file, you or they could make the edit. If you'd rather not touch the shared config, I could instead override the limit in the code. I wouldn't recommend that, since it would leave two sources for the limit.
